name: Laoghaire mac Crimthann

attributes.attribute: consort of the sun goddess Der Greine
won her by killing the giant Goll Mac Morna
was held in Fairyland after answering Fiachna

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Laoghaire mac Crimthann was the consort of the sun goddess Der Greine. He won her by slaying the fearsome giant Goll Mac Morna. The young fairy king Fiachna begged his aid against an invader. Once he entered that realm, Laoghaire could not return and stayed there forever.

okr.objective: Describe Laoghaire mac Crimthann who stayed in Fairyland forever.
key_results: The source names him the consort of the sun goddess Der Greine.
It says he won her by slaying the giant Goll Mac Morna.
It says the fairy king Fiachna lured him into the realm to stay.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (Checkmark 2008), s.v. Laoghaire mac Crimthann.
